alerts.title: Snow, yellow level, Mountain roads in parts of Troms and Finnmark, 2026-10-08T12:00:00+00:00, 2026-10-09T10:00:00+00:00
alerts.area: Mountain roads in parts of Troms and Finnmark
alerts.description: The snow level is expected to drop on Thursday and Friday, and some snow (1-5 cm) may accumulate on roads at higher elevations at times. The snow level is expected to be between 200 and 500 meters above sea level, and locally even lower  Friday morning.
alerts.instruction: Locally difficult driving conditions: Allow extra time for travel and driving. Use appropriate tires and drive according to the conditions. Check road reports on vegvesen.no/trafikk.
